SDTD1.label: Set up teams or departments

SDTD1.1.label: Request to set up teams or departments (incl IP)
SDTD1.1.description: Definition: Use when the customer asks to create or configure teams, departments, groups or their IP access.

SDTD1.2.label: Not enough info
SDTD1.2.description: Definition: Use when organisational setup is requested but the required configuration is unclear.

SDTD1.3.label: Other
SDTD1.3.description: Definition: Use for another team or department management request.

SDTD1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Set up teams or departments'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when the customer asks to create, modify or manage organisational teams, departments or user groups, including their members or permissions, and IP range, and not for a generic bulk account upload.
